_comment: Minimum system RAM in GB an algorithm needs on a CPU, excluding OS and RainbowMiner overhead. Overhead is added separately via MinFreeMemoryGB (config.txt). RandomX values are dataset + cache in fast mode, the per-thread scratchpad is negligible next to those. RandomX and RandomSCASH are confirmed empirically (xmrig logs 'allocated 2336 MB (2080+256)'). The other rx variants default to that same standard parameter set unless a smaller dataset is documented (RandomWow, RandomArq). To verify or correct a value, read the 'allocated N MB' line from that algorithm's miner log. Only list algorithms with a large fixed footprint - a value that is too high silently disables a workable algorithm, a value that is too low simply leaves the old behaviour.
